findings.title: owner@acme.test is an administrator without a second factor
findings.detail: Administrators should enroll an authenticator app or passkey; the tenant authentication policy can require MFA for everyone.

findings.title: alice@acme.test is an administrator without a second factor
findings.detail: Administrators should enroll an authenticator app or passkey; the tenant authentication policy can require MFA for everyone.

findings.title: Policy Everything grants every action on every resource
findings.detail: An unconditional allow of * (or iam:*) on * makes every holder a full administrator. Scope the actions and resources, or add conditions such as principal.mfa.

findings.title: Policy Documents uses service-wide action wildcards
findings.detail: Unconditional documents:* also grants actions added to those services later. List the actions holders need.

findings.title: Service account deploy-bot has full administrator access
findings.detail: A leaked API key would control the whole organization. Bind a role scoped to what the automation does.

findings.title: alice@acme.test holds Admins as standing administrator access
findings.detail: The binding grants full administration permanently and without activation. Make it eligible (just-in-time activation) or give it an expiry.

findings.title: Group Ghosts holds role bindings but has no members
findings.detail: Anyone added later inherits the access immediately; review the bindings.

findings.title: Policy Scoped admin is not attached to any role
findings.detail: Unattached policies grant nothing; delete them or attach them where intended.

findings.title: Role Unused is not bound to anyone
findings.detail: No identity, group, or trust uses this role; remove it if it is no longer needed.
